referenceSources.title: 1972 Detomaso "Pantera" — Audrain Auto Museum
referenceSources.description:
A vibrant yellow 1972 De Tomaso Pantera is showcased indoors under professional lighting, emphasizing its low-slung Italian design and muscular rear end. The Pennsylvania antique historic vehicle plate and “Pantera” script badge underscore its classic status. Below the rear deck, the quad exhaust outlets flank the visible ZF transaxle, hinting at the car’s mid-engine layout and 5-speed transaxle configuration.

Originally powered by a Ford 351 Cleveland V8 bored to 408 cid with over 500 horsepower, this Pantera blends Italian styling by Ghia and Tom Tjaarda with American muscle. The museum’s exhibit notes its 0–60 mph time of 5 seconds, 165 mph top speed, and multiple Concours Italiano awards. A 2016 engine rebuild by specialist Patrick Mical further enhances its performance pedigree.
